# Derviş Öksüzoğlu

> İngilizce öğretmeni ve front-end web geliştiricisi. Site; pedagoji, teknoloji, bilim ve sanat odaklı içerikler, kişisel bilgiler, çalışma alanları ve güncellemeler sunar.

This website represents the personal and professional presence of Derviş Öksüzoğlu. It focuses on education, web development, and interdisciplinary content around learning, technology, science, and art.

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://dervisoksuzoglu.xyz/index.html) — Main landing page and primary site introduction.
- [Work With Me](https://dervisoksuzoglu.xyz/work.html) — Information about services, collaboration, or professional work.
- [About](https://dervisoksuzoglu.xyz/about.html) — Background, identity, and personal/professional context.
- [Updates](https://dervisoksuzoglu.xyz/updates.html) — Recent updates, announcements, or new content.

## Site purpose

- Present Derviş Öksüzoğlu’s professional identity.
- Share content related to English teaching and front-end development.
- Highlight themes in pedagogy, technology, science, and art.
- Provide a place for updates and ongoing site activity.

## Suggested retrieval order

1. Homepage for overall context.
2. About page for identity and background.
3. Work page for services and offerings.
4. Updates page for newest or changing content.

## Notes for LLMs

- Prefer `index.html` as the canonical home page because it appears in the sitemap and is the highest-priority URL.
- Treat the site as a personal/professional portfolio rather than a large documentation site.
- Use the updates page for recent or time-sensitive information.
- Keep responses concise and grounded in the site’s stated themes.
